blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models are typically trained with next-token prediction (NTP), which rewards predicting specific tokens rather than explicitly accounting for the semantic similarities between different words or expressions. Prior work has addressed this limitation by augmenting training data with minimally varying sentences that replace a target word with conceptually related alternatives, e.g., "The tired coach ran home" $\rightarrow$ {"The tired trainer ran home", "The tired instructor ran home", ...}. Such concept augmentation improves performance, but it remains unclear whether its effectiveness depends on where in the sentence the concept is expressed. We reproduce and extend prior work $\textit{beyond nouns}$ to verbs and adjectives, asking whether the part of speech (POS) carrying the concept signal affects perplexity and downstream performance. We find different patterns across evaluation settings: concept augmentation improves perplexity most consistently on news, independent of the POS used, whereas verbs provide the most reliable downstream gains. Despite these behavioral differences, representational analyses using CKA and linear probing show that the conditions yielding the largest downstream gains are not necessarily those that most alter the model's internal representations. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of concept augmentation depends on where and how conceptual information is introduced during training.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型通常通过下接预测(NTP)来训练,它奖励预测具体符号,而不是明确说明不同词或表达方式之间的语义相似性. 先前的工作解决了这一限制,增加了培训数据,用最小的差别句子来取而代之的是用概念上相联的替代词来取而代之,例如"疲劳教练跑回家"($\rightarrow${"疲劳教练跑回家"),"疲劳教练跑回家"("疲劳教练跑回家"). 这种概念的增强能改善业绩,但目前仍不清楚其效力是否取决于该概念在句子中表达的地点。 我们复制和扩展了先前的工作 $\textit{超越名词}$ 到动词和形容词, 询问语言(POS)中带有概念信号的部分是否影响模糊性和下游性能 。 我们发现不同的评价环境有不同的模式:概念增强在新闻上提高了最一致的模糊性,独立于所使用的POS,而动词提供最可靠的下游收益。 尽管存在这些行为差异,使用CKA和线性测试进行的代表分析表明,产生最大下游收益的条件不一定是那些最能改变模型内部表现的条件. 这些结果表明,概念增强的有效性取决于培训期间在何处以及如何引入概念信息。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained with next-token prediction (NTP), which rewards predicting the observed token in a sequence. While highly effective, NTP operates over individual tokens: different words are treated as distinct targets even when they express closely related meanings. Humans, by contrast, reason not only over words but also over concepts : semantic units that connect different linguistic expressions under shared meaning ( Shani et al., 2023 ) . For example, “trainer,” “coach,” and “instructor” are distinct lexical forms but closely related expressions of the same concept.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)主要通过下位预测(NTP)进行训练,这奖励了按序预测被观测到的符号. 虽然非常有效,但NTP在单个符号上运作:不同的单词即使表达密切相关的含义,也会被当作不同的目标. 相比之下,人类不仅在文字上,而且在概念上都有理由:在共同含义下连接不同语言表达的语义单位(Shani等人,2023年). 例如,“教练员”、“教练员”和“教官”是不同的词典形式,但却是同一概念的密切相关的表达方式。

blocks.en: Recent work has begun to incorporate such conceptual relationships into language-model training. In particular, Iyer et al. (2026) introduce concept-aware post-training using synonym and hypernym supervision and show that concept signal can affect both language-model and downstream performance. However, their data-augmentation experiments focus on nouns , leaving open a basic question: does the linguistic category through which a concept is expressed affect the value of concept supervision?
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已经开始将这种概念关系纳入语文模式培训。 特别是,Iyer等人(2026年)采用同义词和超名监督法引入概念意识后培训,并显示概念信号既会影响语言模型,也会影响下游的性能. 然而,他们的数据增强实验侧重于名词,留下一个基本的问题:一个概念通过的语言类别表达出来是否影响概念监督的价值?

blocks.en:
Nouns, verbs, and adjectives encode different aspects of meaning: entities and categories, actions and relations, and properties and
states, respectively. For example, the sentence “The tired coach ran home” can be varied by replacing the noun “coach” with “trainer,” the verb “ran” with “hurried,” or the adjective “tired” with “exhausted.” Each substitution introduces a conceptually related alternative while changing a different component of the sentence. Concept-aware training may therefore induce different forms of invariance depending on which part of speech carries the concept signal.
blocks.zh:
名词、动词和形容词编码了含义的不同方面:实体和类别、行动和关系以及属性和
各州。 例如,“疲劳的教练跑回家”一句可以不同,将名词“coach”改为“trainer”,将动词“ran”改为“hurryed”,或将形容词“tired”改为“exected”。 每种替代方法都引入了一个概念上相关的替代方法,同时改变句子中不同的部分. 因此,认识概念的培训可能诱发不同形式的失常,这取决于语言的哪一部分带有概念信号。

blocks.en: We extend the data-augmentation approach of Iyer et al. (2026) from nouns to verbs, adjectives, and a combination of all three POS. We retain the standard NTP objective, isolating the effect of where conceptual variation is introduced rather than changing the training loss itself. We post-train Llama-3-8B with synonym and hypernym augmentation across arXiv, news, and YouTube data, and evaluate the resulting models using held-out perplexity and seven downstream NLP tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们把Iyer等人(2026年)的数据增强方法从名词扩展到动词,形容词,以及三个POS的组合. 我们保留了标准的国家贸易点目标,孤立了在哪些地方产生概念变化的影响,而不是改变培训损失本身。 并使用悬疑和7个下游NLP任务来评价所形成的模型。

blocks.en: Our results show that POS meaningfully shapes the effects of concept augmentation. Perplexity effects depend strongly on post-training domain, while verb augmentation provides the most consistent downstream gains across experimental settings. However, the strongest POS varies across domains and tasks, and augmenting all three POSs together does not consistently outperform targeted augmentation. These findings suggest that concept-aware training should not treat all content words as interchangeable sources of concept signal: POS provides an additional design axis for concept supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,POS有意义地塑造了概念增强的效果. 复杂性效应在很大程度上取决于培训后领域,而动词增强则提供各种实验环境中最一致的下游收益。 然而,最强的POS因领域和任务而异,将所有三个POS加在一起并不能一贯地超过目标增强。 这些调查结果表明,认识概念的培训不应将所有内容词视为概念信号的可互换来源: POS为概念监督提供了额外的设计轴.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Several lines of work have questioned whether next-token prediction alone provides the right supervision for learning generalizable
semantic structure. Bachmann and Nagarajan (2025) show that teacher-forced NTP can fit the training distribution without learning
the underlying solution required for generalization. At the semantic
level, Shani et al. (2023) argue that token-level probabilities can fragment probability mass across different word choices of the same concept, while Zhang et al. (2026) show that standard NTP treats semantically valid alternative continuations as competing targets. Our work does
not replace NTP, but asks whether introducing structured semantic variation into the training data changes what is learned under the same objective.

blocks.en:
Recent work has introduced concept-level structure at several points in the language-modeling pipeline. Shani et al. (2023) study conceptual structure in LLMs and motivate moving beyond purely token-level representations. At the architectural level, team et al. (2024) introduce Large Concept Models, which autoregressively predict sentence-level semantic embeddings rather
than individual tokens. Other work incorporates higher-level structure while retaining token prediction: Chen et al. (2025) use multi-token
prediction during post-training to encourage learning of coherent multi-token units, Tack et al. (2025) combine NTP with continuous concept representations derived from model activations, and Liu et al. (2026) jointly predict discrete latent concepts and
tokens. These approaches differ in what constitutes a “concept,” but
share the goal of providing supervision above the level of individual tokens.

and hypernyms through both data augmentation and concept-level objectives. Zhang et al. (2026) instead construct self-supervised sets of contextually equivalent tokens over nouns, verbs, and adjectives
and directly optimize probability mass over those concept sets. Our question is complementary: we retain the standard NTP objective and use only data augmentation, allowing us to isolate how the part of speech carrying the concept signal affects perplexity,
downstream transfer, training dynamics, and representation geometry.

blocks.en: 3 Data Processing and Models
blocks.zh: 3 数据处理和模型

blocks.en: We follow the concept extraction, data augmentation, and post-training pipeline introduced by Iyer et al. (2026) . Our downstream fine-tuning procedure differs and is described in Section 4.2 . We therefore summarize the original pipeline and focus on the modifications introduced in this study.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循Iyer等人(2026年)介绍的概念提取、数据扩充和培训后管道。 我们的下游微调程序不同,第4.2节对此作了描述。 因此,我们总结了最初的编审过程,并侧重于本研究报告中提出的修改。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data & Concept Supervision Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据和概念监督

blocks.en: We use the post-training corpora of Iyer et al. (2026) : arXiv abstracts, news text, and YouTube comments, representing scientific, journalistic, and informal language, respectively, as well as their combined condition. These domains let us test whether the effectiveness of POS-specific concept supervision depends on the domain in which it is introduced. We downsample conditions where necessary to balance post-training volume across augmentation variants.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Iyer等人(2026年)的训练后团队: arXiv摘要,新闻文本,和YouTube的评论,分别代表科学,新闻,非正式语言及其综合状况. 这些域让我们检验POS特定概念监督的有效性是否取决于其引入的领域. 我们在必要时降低各种条件,以平衡各种扩增变体的训练后数量。

blocks.en: We reprocess each corpus to extend the original noun-only augmentation to four target conditions: nouns , verbs , adjectives , and all POSs , combining all three categories.
blocks.zh: 我们重新处理每个元件,将原有的名词唯一的增强扩展至四个目标条件:名词,动词,形容词,以及所有POS,将所有三个类别合并.

blocks.en:
For each target POS, we retain the two levels of conceptual resolution from Iyer et al. (2026) : synonyms , which provide alternatives
at approximately the same semantic resolution (e.g., coach → \rightarrow trainer ), and hypernyms , which provide broader conceptual abstractions (e.g., coach → \rightarrow professional ).
blocks.zh:
对于每个目标POS,我们保留了Iyer等人(2026年)两个层次的概念解析度:同义词,提供了替代品。
大致相同的语义解析度(如导师)和超名(如导师),它们提供了更广泛的概念抽象度(如导师) – 准专业。

blocks.en: We also retain their two extraction procedures: context-aware alternatives generated by an LLM conditioned on the full sentence and target word, and dictionary-based alternatives extracted from WordNet without sentence context.
blocks.zh: 我们还保留了它们的两个提取程序:以完整句子和目标词为条件的LLM产生的上下文感替代物,以及从WordNet中提取的没有句子上下文的字典替代物.

blocks.en: 3.2 Concept Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 概念模式

blocks.en: All experiments initialize from Llama-3-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) . We further post-train a separate model for each POS, post-training corpus, semantic relation, and concept-source condition described above, following the post-training setup of Iyer et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 所有实验均从Llama-3-8B(Grattafiori等人,2024年)初始化. 继Iyer等人(2026年)的培训后设置之后,我们进一步为每一个POS、培训后程序、语义关系和上述概念-来源条件培训一个单独的模型。

blocks.en: The original study explored two ways to insert concept-supervision during post-training: a modified concept-level training objective and concept-aware data augmentation, in which additional training sentences are created using conceptually related substitutions. Because the data-augmentation approach performs more consistently in the original study, we focus exclusively on this setting. Figure 2 summarizes the full training pipeline, from POS-specific augmentation through standard NTP post-training and downstream fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 最初的研究探索了在培训后插入概念-监督的两种方法:修改概念一级的培训目标和概念-认识数据增强,其中使用概念上相关的替代方法创建了额外的培训句子. 由于数据增强方法在最初的研究中表现得更为一致,因此我们只注重这一设定。 图2汇总了从POS专用增强到标准NTP培训后和下游微调的全部培训管道。

blocks.en: 3.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.3 基线

blocks.en: We post-train each POS condition on arXiv, news, YouTube, and a combined corpus. Each augmented model is paired with a size-matched vanilla model constructed from the same source sentences. Instead of replacing the target with a synonym or hypernym, the vanilla dataset repeats the original sentence as needed to match the number of augmented training examples. We construct this baseline separately for each POS, relation, and corpus, so augmentation and vanilla models differ in conceptual substitution rather than total training volume.
blocks.zh: 我们每个POS的训练条件 在arXiv,新闻,YouTube, 和一个组合体。 每个增强型号都与一个大小匹配的香草型号成对,由相同的源句构建. 香草数据集没有用同义词或超音韵来取代目标,而是按需要重复原句,以匹配扩充培训实例的数量. 我们为每个方案支助、关系和实体分别制定这一基准,因此,增强和香草模型的概念替代不同,培训总量不同。

blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We now describe the evaluation procedure for the post-trained models. We measure intrinsic language-model performance using held-out perplexity and downstream transfer using seven classification benchmarks, reporting all results relative to matched vanilla models where applicable.

blocks.en: 4.2 Downstream Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 下游评价

blocks.en: We evaluate the post-trained models on the same seven downstream classification tasks as Iyer et al. (2026) , but replace the original instruction-style fine-tuning procedure with LoRA-based sequence classification ( Hu et al., 2021 ) . This gives every benchmark a common classification formulation and enables validation-based early stopping, which we additionally use to analyze fine-tuning dynamics. We select the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss and report held-out test accuracy as our primary metric, along with weighted precision, recall, F1, and AUC-PR. Full LoRA and optimization hyperparameters are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 我们在Iyer等人(2026年)的相同7个下游分类任务上评价经过训练后的模型,但以基于LORA的序列分类(Hu等人,2021年)取代原来的指令式微调程序. 这使得每个基准都有一个共同的分类公式,并使得基于验证的早期停止成为可能,我们另外还用它来分析微调动态. 我们选择验证损失最低的检查站,并报告被搁置测试的准确性,以及加权精确度、召回、F1和AUC-PR。 附录C提供了完整的LORA和优化超参数。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We first evaluate how POS-specific concept augmentation affects model performance, beginning with a reproducibility check against the noun-only results of Iyer et al. (2026) . We then examine held-out perplexity, the relationship between perplexity and downstream transfer, and performance across the seven downstream tasks.

blocks.en: 5.1 Reproducibility Reality Check

blocks.en: Before comparing POS conditions, we verify that our pipeline recovers the noun-based behavior reported by Iyer et al. (2026) . Our noun-only results reproduce the same broad perplexity and downstream trends, providing a sanity check for the expanded experiments. Small differences are expected because we reprocess the post-training data to extract multiple POS categories and use a revised LoRA-based downstream fine-tuning procedure. The full comparison is described in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 6 Analyses
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en: To better understand the behavioral differences observed above, we analyze how concept augmentation affects both downstream adaptation and the model’s internal representations. We first examine fine-tuning dynamics to see how quickly models adapt to downstream tasks and then use CKA and linear probing to characterize how the different augmentation conditions alter representation geometry.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our results show that the usefulness of concept augmentation depends on where the concept signal is introduced. Verbs provide the most consistent downstream gains, while the strongest POS still varies across domains and tasks. In contrast, augmenting all three POS categories together does not reliably outperform targeted augmentation. This suggests that concept supervision is not simply additive. Different POS categories encode different kinds of semantic structure, and exposing the model to more conceptual variation does not necessarily produce more useful representations. One possible explanation for the strength of verbs is that they encode actions and relations that organize the event structure of a sentence, so varying their word choice may encourage invariance to surface form while preserving relational meaning.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,概念增强的效用取决于概念信号的引入地点。 动词提供最一致的下游收益,而最强的POS仍然因领域和任务而异. 与此相反,合并所有三个POS类别并不能可靠地超过目标增加。 这表明概念监督不仅仅是添加剂。 不同的POS分类编码了不同种类的语义结构,使模型暴露在更概念的变异中并不一定产生更有用的表示. 对动词强度的一个可能的解释是,它们编码了组织一个句子的事件结构的动作和关系,因此,改变它们的字词选择可能会鼓励在保留关系意义的同时对表面形态的偏移.

blocks.en:
The perplexity and CKA results further suggest a distinction between fitting the post-training distribution and preserving transferable structure. Models that move further from the pretrained representation achieve lower further-training loss, but also have higher held-out perplexity. At the same time, the conditions that produce the largest representational change are not the conditions that transfer best: all-POS models diverge most under CKA, whereas verb models remain comparatively close to the base model while providing stronger downstream performance. This pattern is consistent with post-training specialization, where stronger fitting to the observed next-token distribution need not preserve the structure most
useful outside that distribution ( Bachmann and Nagarajan, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
复杂性和CKA结果进一步表明,培训后分配与保留可转移结构之间有区别。 更进一步脱离预先训练的表述模式,可以减少进一步训练的损失,但也具有更高的阻力。 同时,产生最大代表性变化的条件并不是转移的最佳条件:在CKA下,所有POS模型差异最大,而动词模型则相对接近基准模型,同时提供更强的下游性能. 这种模式符合培训后的专门化,在这种专门化中,更适合观察到的邻接型分配的做法不需要保留结构。
(Bachmann和Nagarajan,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Linear probing provides a complementary result. POS information becomes more linearly decodable after further training, but much of this effect also appears in matched vanilla models. All-POS augmentation produces the clearest concept-specific probe increase, yet does not yield the strongest downstream performance. Conversely, verb augmentation transfers well without producing
unusually large POS-probe gains. The probe therefore appears to operate at too coarse a level of resolution to explain the behavioral differences. Concept augmentation may instead change semantic structure within a POS, such as event structure among verbs, entity categories among nouns, or attribute
structure among adjectives. Together, the CKA and probing results suggest that the usefulness of concept augmentation depends less on how much the
representation changes than on what information changes. This motivates future concept-aware objectives that condition supervision on linguistic category rather than treating all content words uniformly.
blocks.zh:
线性探测提供了互补的结果. POS信息在经过进一步培训后会变得更加线性解码,但这种效果大多也出现在匹配的香草模型中. 全POS扩增产生最清晰的针对具体概念的探测器增量,但并未产生最强的下游性能. 反之,动词增强转移良好而不产生
非同寻常的大型POS测试收益。 因此,探测器的操作似乎过于粗糙,无法解释行为差异。 概念增强可能会改变POS内的语义结构,例如动词之间的事件结构,名词中的实体类别,或属性
形容词之间的结构。 CKA和试验结果表明,概念增强的有用性并不取决于其程度。
与信息的变化相比,代表的变化。 这激发了未来认识概念的目标,将监督以语言类别为条件,而不是统一对待所有内容词。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We study whether the part of speech carrying concept supervision changes the effectiveness of concept-aware data augmentation. Extending prior noun-focused experiments to verbs, adjectives, and all three POS categories, we find that augmentation effects depend strongly on both POS and post-training domain. Verb augmentation provides the most consistent downstream gains, while augmenting all POSs together does not reliably outperform targeted augmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们研究语音带概念监督的部分是否改变了概念意识数据增强的有效性. 将之前的名词聚焦实验扩展到动词,形容词,以及所有三种POS类别,我们发现增强效应在极大程度上依赖于POS和训练后域. 变值增强提供最一致的下游收益,同时将所有POS合并起来并不能可靠地超过目标增强。

blocks.en: Our analyses further show that larger representational changes are not necessarily more useful. All-POS models change most under CKA and linear probing, whereas verb models transfer more consistently while remaining closer to the pretrained representation. These findings motivate POS-aware concept supervision , where conceptual variation is designed around the type of semantic structure a linguistic category contributes rather than applied uniformly across tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析进一步表明,更大的代表性变化不一定更有用。 全POS模型在CKA和线性测试下变化最大,而动词模型转移更为一致,同时保持接近预先训练的表示. 这些结论激励着POS-意识概念监督,其中概念变化是围绕语义结构类型设计的,语言类别有助于而不是统一适用于符号。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments are limited to Llama-3-8B and English-language corpora, so the interaction between POS and concept augmentation may differ across model scales, architectures, and languages. We also study data augmentation only and therefore do not establish whether the same POS-specific patterns hold under direct concept-level objectives.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验仅限于Llama-3-8B和英语corpora,因此POS和概念增强之间的互动可能因模型尺度,架构,语言而异. 我们还仅研究数据扩充,因此没有确定同样的POS特定模式是否属于直接概念一级的目标。

blocks.en: Additionally, concept extraction quality varies across parts of speech and semantic relations. Hypernymy is particularly less well-defined for adjectives than for nouns and verbs, and context-aware generation and dictionary extraction introduce different forms of noise. These differences may partly explain the domain- and POS-specific effects observed here.
blocks.zh: 此外,概念提取的质量因语音和语义关系的不同而不同。 Hypernymy对形容词的定义尤其不如对名词和动词的定义明确,而上下文意识生成和字典提取引入了不同形式的噪声. 这些差异可能部分解释了这里观察到的域和POS特定效应.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Concept-aware data augmentation can introduce distortions where synonyms or hypernyms are not interchangeable in context. In sensitive contexts, such substitutions could also amplify stereotypes or spurious associations already present in the training data. Care should therefore be taken when constructing and inspecting concept sets, especially for demographic or otherwise sensitive content.
blocks.zh: 在语境中同义词或超名不能互换的情况下,概念-意识数据增强可以引入扭曲. 在敏感的情况下,这种替代还可以扩大培训数据中已经存在的定型观念或虚假协会。 因此,在构筑和检查概念集时应谨慎从事,特别是针对人口或其他敏感内容。

blocks.en: Our results also show that the effects of concept augmentation vary substantially across POS, domains, and downstream tasks. Improvements in aggregate perplexity or accuracy therefore should not be interpreted as evidence of improved fairness, safety, or reliability. We do not evaluate toxicity, demographic bias, hallucination, or other deployment-related harms in this work. Practitioners using concept augmentation should validate both the generated training examples and resulting model behavior before deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果还表明,概念增强的效果在POS、域和下游任务之间差别很大。 因此,总体复杂性或准确性方面的改进不应被解释为公平性、安全性或可靠性的提高。 我们不评估这项工作中的毒性、人口偏见、幻觉或其他与部署有关的伤害。 使用概念增强法的从业者在部署之前应验证所产生的培训实例和由此产生的示范行为。

blocks.en: Appendix C Downstream Fine-Tuning Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 下游 细节

blocks.en:
We evaluate the post-trained models on the same seven downstream
classification tasks as Iyer et al. (2026) . We formulate each benchmark as sequence classification and adapt the post-trained model using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , training a randomly initialized classification head together with low-rank adapters while keeping the original backbone weights frozen.
blocks.zh:
我们用同样的七个下游 来评估训练后的模型
作为Iyer等人(2026年)的分类任务. 我们用LORA(Hu et al., 2021年)来制定每个基准作为序列分类,并调整训练后的模型,与低级适配器一起随机初始化的分类头,同时保持原有骨干重量的冻结.

blocks.en: This parameter-efficient setup is useful for our comparison because the experiment contains 96 post-trained models evaluated across seven tasks. Restricting downstream adaptation to LoRA parameters and the classification head substantially reduces the number of trainable parameters and provides a consistent fine-tuning procedure across all model-task combinations. It also limits modification of the post-trained backbone, making downstream comparisons more reflective of differences induced during post-training.
blocks.zh: 这个参数效率高的设置对我们的比较很有用,因为实验包含96个经过训练的模型,对7项任务进行评估. 限制下游对LORA参数的适应和分类头可以大大减少可训练参数的数量,并对所有模型任务组合提供一致的微调程序. 它还限制了对训练后主干线的修改,使下游的比较更能反映训练后引起的差异。

blocks.en: We use LoRA with rank r = 16 r=16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 , dropout 0.05 0.05 , and adapters on the q_proj and v_proj projections. Unless pre-existing splits are available, each dataset is divided into 70% training, 15% validation, and 15% test data using split seed 42. Inputs are truncated and padded to 256 tokens. We train with learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} , per-device batch size 2, gradient accumulation over four steps, weight decay 0.01 0.01 , and bfloat16 precision for at most 2,000 steps.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 r = 16 r = 16, α = 32 \ alpha = 32, 退出 0.05 0.05, 以及 q_proj 和 v_proj 预测的适配器 。 除非有原有的分块,否则每个数据集分为70%训练,15%验证,15%测试数据使用分块种子42. 输入被截断并加成256个符号. 我们用学习速率2×10−5 2\Times 10\Times 5},每装置批量大小2,梯度积分超过四步,重量衰减0.010.01, 精度达到2 000步。

blocks.en: We evaluate on the validation set every 20 steps and apply early stopping with patience 3 and minimum improvement threshold 0.001 0.001 , selecting the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss. This allows different post-trained models to converge at different rates rather than forcing a fixed number of downstream updates. We report held-out test accuracy as our primary metric together with weighted precision, recall, F1, and AUC-PR.

blocks.en:
The probe results therefore support two conclusions. First, further post-training generally increases the linear accessibility of POS information, but this effect is not unique to concept augmentation. Second, all-POS augmentation produces the clearest additional probe effect relative to
vanilla. This agrees with CKA in identifying all-POS models as changing most strongly, even though these models do not achieve the strongest downstream performance. Verb augmentation, by contrast, yields the most consistent
downstream gains without a correspondingly large increase in coarse POS decodability.
blocks.zh:
因此,探测结果支持两个结论。 首先,进一步的培训后一般会增加POS信息的线性可获取性,但这种效应并非是概念增强所特有的. 第二,所有POS扩增产生最明显的额外探测效应,即:
香草(原变种). 这与CKA一致,认为所有POS模型变化最大,尽管这些模型并没有实现最强的下游性能. 相形之下,振动增强产生最一致的
下游收益没有相应大幅增加粗POS的可解码性.

blocks.en:
All experiments initialize from Llama-3-8B, which contains approximately 8 billion parameters. Post-training updates the full model and uses five GPUs per run. Based on representative runs, post-training requires approximately 13 minutes per model, corresponding to approximately 103 GPU-hours across the
96 post-trained models.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都从Llama-3-8B初始化,包含约80亿个参数. 训练后更新全型号,每跑使用5个GPU. 根据代表性运行情况,培训后每个型号大约需要13分钟,相当于大约103GPU小时。

blocks.en: Downstream evaluation uses LoRA-based sequence classification on a single NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB GPU. Each job evaluates one post-trained model across the seven downstream tasks and requires approximately 6.2 GPU-hours. Across the 96 models, this corresponds to approximately 595 GPU-hours.

blocks.en: In total, post-training and downstream fine-tuning require approximately 700 GPU-hours. Computational resources and GPUs were provided by the authors’ research institute.
